# Endocrine_Modulated_Network_State

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A global physiological state shift driven by endocrine signals that reconfigures neural network dynamics and immune responses across tissues. Analogous to global neuromodulation in spiking networks, this concept guides the implementation of state-dependent computation in in-network neuromorphic processors.
